findings.claim: ABBV 10-K FY2025：美國三大批發商（McKesson、Cardinal、Cencora）占美國藥品銷售幾乎全部，單一批發商不超過美國毛營收 43%。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, three wholesale distributors (McKesson Corporation, Cardinal Health, Inc. and Cencora, Inc.) accounted for substantially all of AbbVie's pharmaceutical product sales in the United States. No individual wholesaler accounted for greater than 43% of AbbVie's 2025 gross revenues in the United States.
